findings: RI-CMB01 is structurally honest: §A holds upstream DS1/DS3 numbers as community-data (medium), §B is an explicitly CONSTRUCTED model 'ES-ROLL/1' that openly states it blends DS3's 30%/70% breakpoints with DS1's i-frame stinginess. The blend is DECLARED, not silent. Verification target = §A cells only.
RI-CMB01 already self-corrects the commissioning brief: says DS1 breakpoints are 25%/50%, not 30%/70%. Needs external check.

RI-CMB02 is fully `constructed` and explicitly disclaims being a measurement of any FromSoft title. Nothing in §A/§B to verify against a game; only the qualitative 'grounding' claims (canonical-recall) are checkable.
RI-CMB01 §A claims: DS1 25/50/100 breakpoints, 11 iframes all DS1 rolls, 13 for ninja-flip (DWGR at <=25%); DS3 30/70/100, 13/13/12 iframes light/medium/heavy.
VERIFIED SOURCE: fandom API works where WebFetch/curl get 403. Use https://<wiki>.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=<Page>&prop=wikitext&format=json

DS1 roll frame table (darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Rolling): ALL roll types 11 i-frames; Ninja Flip (DWGR, <=25%) 13. Totals: fast 21-24f, mid 31-33f, fat 46-48f. Instability frames (1.4x dmg taken): fast 7-8, mid 14, fat 25, ninja flip 0. Breakpoints 25%/50%/100% CONFIRMED. Frames are 30fps (PTDE) - fast roll 24f=0.80s is right for a Souls roll; at 60fps it'd be 0.4s which is too fast.
DS3 CONFIRMED: 30%/70%/100% breakpoints; 13 i-frames light+medium, 12 heavy (Fextralife Equipment Load / Steam).

MAJOR: RI-CMB01 §A compares DS1's 11 i-frames against DS3's 13 WITHOUT normalising framerate. DS1 is 30fps -> 11f = 0.367s. DS3 is 60fps -> 13f = 0.217s. So DS1 is ~69% MORE invulnerable in wall-clock, not less. §B's stated rationale ('DS1's stinginess ... fewer i-frames than DS3') is built on a framerate conflation. This is the brief's exact predicted failure.

DECISIVE: Souls community i-frame counts are quoted in 1/30 s ticks for ALL of DS1/DS3/ER. Evidence: DS3 Carthus Bloodring 'raises i-frames from 12 (.4 sec) to 16 (.533 sec)' -> 12/0.4 = 30 fps exactly (Steam https://steamcommunity.com/app/374320/discussions/0/1733217528121996749/). Elden Ring Reforged wiki states outright 'i-frames values are at 30 FPS' (https://err.fandom.com/wiki/Combat_Mechanics).

THEREFORE the headline finding: RI-CMB01 §B ES-ROLL/1 adopts the Souls FRAME NUMBERS (13/11/5) but re-bases them on a 60 Hz sim. Real-time: our LIGHT roll = 13/60 = 217 ms invuln, 26/60 = 433 ms total. DS3 light roll = 13/30 = 433 ms invuln; DS1 fast roll = 11/30 = 367 ms invuln, 24/30 = 800 ms total. Our roll is ~HALF the wall-clock duration and half the invulnerability of every game cited. The i-frame FRACTION (0.50 vs DS1 0.458) is preserved, so it will pass every internal check while feeling twice as fast as Souls.

DS3 Fextralife Equipment Load page CONFIRMS: 29.9% / 30.0-70.0 / 70.1-99.9 / 100%+; 13/13/12 i-frames; fat roll 'stamina regenerates about 20% slower' -> corroborates RI-CMB03's x0.80 regen multiplier at >70% load; 'Unlike Dark Souls 1, Equip Load has no impact on run speed under 100%'. URL https://darksouls3.wiki.fextralife.com/Equipment+Load

DIVERGENCE (declared-constructed, worth recording): DS3 light and medium rolls have the SAME total duration (light only covers more distance). RI-CMB01 gives LIGHT 26f vs MEDIUM 30f - that is the DS1 model (fast 24f / mid 33f), not DS3's. So §B's breakpoints are DS3's but its duration model is DS1's - a second, undeclared blend on top of the declared one.
